notes.title: The next update
notes.content:
As we venture into Day 6's night, things are heating up quite a bit. I think it's time to talk and take a look into what's coming.
From now on and until the morning of Day 7, the updates to come will each explore a different path. V0.6.6 will focus on three routes: [i]Eve Love, Dual Love, and Weird Triangle[/i]. 
The house is sinking into the night, Cassie is taking care of Kelly, and Jack, having toured the home one last time, is ready to knock on Eve's door for a "heart-to-heart conversation". 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101244/eb087fc57f56a0f6ae6a7a708c2dd7ffd01f09a3.jpg[/img]

[h2]V0.6.6 will come with animations.[/h2]
Shyly for now with some very short loops. My skills aren't enough yet to produce anything else but I do not despair to improve soon. It's a lot of work and time invested for what looks like minimal results, but given the feedback I received so far, that feels necessary.

[h2]The road to Day 7.[/h2]
Every remaining scene will contain some naughtiness. You can expect a decent amount of action.
[list]
[*]v0.6.7 will be about [i]Kelly's Love and the Moronic Hero[/i] paths with three scenes: 33, 34 and 35.
[*]v0.6.8 will be about [i]Eve's sub paths and Cassie's Love[/i] path. It will include five scenes: 36, 37, 38, 39 and 40.
[*]v0.6.9 will be about [i]Cassie and the Dual Dom[/i] routes. Scenes 41, 42, and 43.
[*]V0.6.10, finally will contain [i]the Neutral path[/i] scene, scene 44. And yes, that one too will be an erotic scene.
[/list]
I want to provide a comparable and consistent amount of content across all paths, which means that each update until Day 7 should be roughly the same size with a word count between 15k and 20k words and 500 to 700 images to illustrate the story. 

I hope you will like what's to come.
Thank you for your support and for reading me.

[i]The Naughty Captain.[/i]
